name: custtoolset_pillar4_extractor
description: Analyzes NetSuite customizations to identify architectural redundancy, unused custom fields, and logic collisions between User Event scripts and SuiteFlows.

analysisType.description: The specific customization analysis to execute. Use 'data_sparsity' to pull custom records/entities for null-rate checking, 'workflow_redundancy' to identify workflows that trigger but abort, or 'logic_collisions' to find overlapping Scripts and Workflows on the same record type.

returns.description: A JSON payload containing structural metadata, workflow execution summaries, or script/workflow deployment matrices.
